, to improve vegetable consumption among young adults, interventions should be targeted to increase PBC and subjective norms, as well as to change attitudes towards vegetables consumption, particularly among men, students enrolled in courses other food science, and those doing less physical activity.

the TPB model is useful to understand the determinants of vegetable consumption among young adults, but it should be further improved by considering socio-demographic and personal variables.

the TPB is a valid and robust model to understand and predict vegetables consumption among young people, and that the TPB can be used to design effective interventions for increasing vegetable consumption.
